function_name.description: Unique identifier of the GIS tool function matching its implementation name.

documentation.description: Clear explanation of what the GIS function does, its behavior, and computational logic.

inputs.description: Map of input argument names to their expected data types (e.g. raster, vector_point, vector_polygon, string, numeric).

example_user_questions.description: Sample queries or questions from policy makers that map to this function.
